title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
authors: Llama Team, AI @ Meta (Aaron Grattafiori, Abhimanyu Dubey, Abhinav Jauhri and about 550 more; the full list is the paper's appendix)
date: July 2024 (dated 23 July 2024; arXiv v1 31 July 2024, v3 23 November 2024)

code.title: meta-llama/llama-models
code.note: Meta's model repository: model cards, the Llama 3.1 Community License, the chat format and reference inference code (about 20 minutes for the README and entry path). The training code is not released

takeaway: Meta's full playbook for a GPT-4-class open model: 405B dense on 15.6T tokens (50/25/17/8 data mix, 3-stage recipe with 128K long-context extension and annealing), six rounds of RM + rejection sampling + SFT + DPO, on 16K H100s at 38-43% MFU with 419 unexpected interruptions in 54 days (78% hardware) yet >90% effective training time.
verdict: Believe the engineering record: the cluster, the parallelism layout, the failure log and the recipe are the most detailed public account of a frontier-scale run, and its scaling-law forecast reproduces from its own figures. Read the benchmark claims as approximate: rivals' scores mix self-run and reported numbers, many gaps sit inside the noise, and the paper's own human evaluation has the 405B behind GPT-4o rather than level with it.

kb.t: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
kb.n: 2020: the ancestor of the scaling-law method; Llama 3 adds a second stage from loss to benchmark accuracy.
2023: the alignment loss Llama 3 scales up, with formatting tokens masked and an NLL term added.
2022: the PPO-based RLHF pipeline Llama 3 explicitly moves away from.
2023: used here to more than double rejection-sampling throughput.
2021: rotary position embeddings, with the base raised to 500,000 here for long context.
2019: the tensor parallelism that is the innermost of the four dimensions.
2019: the sharded data parallelism that FSDP implements, the outermost dimension.
2022: the attention kernel family that makes 128K-token training affordable.
December 2024: the counterpoint, mixture of experts, FP8 training and RL-heavy post-training, against Llama 3's dense-and-simple bet.
